papers.title: Effect of the build angle applied in Inconel 718 alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion on the strengthening mechanisms of the micro-blasting process

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光粉末床熔融Inconel 718合金的构建角度对微喷丸强化机制的影响，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or biomedical implant context; it focuses on micro-blasting of Inconel 718 for non-biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究构建角度对LPBF Inconel 718微喷丸强化效果的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同构建角度的试样，进行微喷丸处理并分析微观组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 构建角度影响微喷丸引入的残余应力和微观结构演变，进而影响强化机制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观表征验证强化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how the build angle in laser powder bed fusion affects the strengthening mechanisms induced by micro-blasting in Inconel 718 alloy.
summary_en.method: Samples fabricated at different build angles were subjected to micro-blasting, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: The build angle significantly influences the residual stress and microstructural evolution introduced by micro-blasting, thereby altering the strengthening mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: The strengthening effects were validated through mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: The combined impact of tranexamic acid protocol and drainage on blood loss in primary total hip arthroplasty a retrospective cohort study

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于全髋关节置换术中的止血药物与引流方案，与股骨假体生物力学、应力遮挡或有限元分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling; it is purely a clinical retrospective study on blood loss management.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估氨甲环酸联合引流对全髋置换术后失血的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列分析，比较不同止血与引流方案的患者失血量。
summary_zh.result: 联合方案显著减少失血，但未涉及生物力学指标。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者数据的回顾性统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the combined effect of tranexamic acid protocol and drainage on perioperative blood loss in primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing blood loss outcomes across different combinations of tranexamic acid administration and drainage strategies.
summary_en.result: The combined protocol significantly reduced blood loss, but no biomechanical outcomes were assessed.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through retrospective analysis of patient records.
